description: Searches the Ontario mortgage rates lenders have published, as recorded by Open Mortgage Rates, using filters such as mortgageType, term, position, minimumLtv, purpose or a lender keyword; with no filter it asks what to search for instead of listing every record. Returns each lender's own rate wording with its conditions, check date and source link, and a notice that goes with them. Useful when someone asks what rates lenders are publishing. It takes filters only, not names, contact details or dollar amounts. Published information, not a quote, offer, recommendation or eligibility assessment.

keyword.description: A lender name or a directory keyword such as "credit union", not a person's name or other personal details.

minimumLtv.description: Loan-to-value the user needs, as a percent, rounded UP to the next listed value. Use "all" when it cannot be worked out from what the user said.

mortgageType.description: Use "all" unless the user names or clearly describes a category.

purpose.description: "refinance" when the user says they are refinancing, taking equity out or consolidating debt; otherwise "all".

name: search_published_mortgage_rates
title: Search published mortgage rates
